title: Acceptance Orbit Coordinator Playbook — Remote Hardware & Offer Handoff
content:
Purpose: quick, repeatable playbook for the person owning the offer->acceptance->first-14d remote setup flow. Focus: contractors & full-time hires who need shipped hardware, access, and a low-friction first week.

Audience: People Ops Coordinators, Hiring Managers, IT Fulfillment partner.

Status: draft — experiments v1 (we ran 6 pilots in Q4 2025; this incorporates learnings).

Top-level flow (one line): Offer accepted -> Acceptance Orbit Coordinator (AOC) triggers handoff checklist -> IT + Security + Manager prepare -> Candidate receives welcome pack + hardware -> Day 0-14 quiet-start sprint.

Quick roles & responsibilities (who does what):
- AOC (owner): single point of contact for candidate, triggers all tasks, confirms shipping & access, runs week-1 check-ins.
- Hiring Manager: schedules welcome 30/60/90 syncs, provides team buddy, shares first-week sprint goals.
- IT Fulfillment: hardware pick/pack/ship, provisioning image, MDM enrollment, serial tracking.
- Security: account approvals, MFA exemption gating, CLA/contract signature confirmation.
- Buddy: peer for shadowing and immediate onboarding.

Checklist (Tasks AOC runs immediately after acceptance):
[ ] Confirm acceptance time zone & preferred delivery address (ask about PO Box, roommate sign-off).
[ ] Send "Acceptance Orbit" email template (copy below) within 2 hours.
[ ] Create candidate onboarding ticket in Jira (PEOPLE-451X) and tag Hiring Manager + IT Fulfillment.
[ ] Start hardware worksheet row (itemize laptop, power, dongles, monitor if approved, peripherals).
[ ] Kick off background contract signature (Legal) and verify completed e-sign.
[ ] Raise access requests: Google org, Slack, HRIS, payroll sync (if applicable).
[ ] Confirm start date + send calendar hold for Day 0 orientation + buddy intro.

Hardware provisioning matrix (fast mapper for typical roles):
- SWE (senior): MacBook Pro 14/16 (M3 Pro), 1 monitor, USB-C dock, travel case.
- SWE (junior/contractor): MacBook Air M2, single monitor (optional), dongles.
- Platform/SRE: Linux image variant, extra power brick, 2-monitor kit.
- Design/PM: MacBook or Windows (preference), color-calibrated monitor for design.
Notes: default to smallest-surface-fulfillment that meets SLA (cost + speed). If manager requests expedited/upgrade, require approval thread.

Shipping playbook notes:
- Default shipper: Redwood IT fulfillment partner (domestic 3–5 business days). International: pre-approve customs docs; require candidate passport/ID in secure upload.
- Ship method: insured + signature required for hires with >$2k hardware value.
- Tracking: AOC monitors until candidate confirms receipt.

Acceptance Orbit email template (send within 2 hours):
Subject: Welcome to Redwood — next steps + hardware & start date
Body (short): Hi <Name> — huge welcome. I’m Asha (People Ops). Quick notes: your start date is <date>. I’m coordinating laptop & access — please reply with best shipping address and phone for delivery. Expect a follow-up from IT with tracking. I’ll send orientation calendar invites and a short pre-onboard checklist. If you have any immediate accommodation needs, tell me here.

Day 0-14 Quiet-Start sprint (what we want the new hire to achieve vs signals AOC/manager watch):
- Day 0: orientation (90m), Slack + Google access confirmed, hardware check, buddy intro.
- Day 1-3: environment setup, run dev-image build (SWE), complete security training, get first small ticket.
- Day 4-7: pair on a tiny feature/bug, meet cross-functional partners.
- Day 8-14: deliver first small PR or doc, 1:1 with manager cadence set, first 14-day retro.
Signals to watch (early risk flags):
- No hardware confirmation by Day 3 -> escalates to IT lead + expedited replacement.
- Access denied to org resources -> security ticket created and monitored hourly.
- Candidate silence after acceptance -> AOC makes phone call; escalate to Hiring Manager by 48 hours.

Interview calibration & handoff rubric (short, for hiring managers & AOC to ensure loop quality):
- Evidence required on offer packet: coding exercise outcome summary (SWE), portfolio link (Design), reference check notes.
- Manager confirms role-level success metrics for first 30/60/90 days (2–4 bullet outcomes).
- Interview calibration: for each hire, save one example interview transcript/snippet that demonstrates level (store in linked_artifacts).
- Hiring decision quality check (pre-offer): Did at least two interviewers explicitly rate candidate on ‘impact’ and ‘signal'? If no, do one extra calibration touch.

Candidate communication cadence (AOC defaults):
- T+0 (offer acceptance): Acceptance Orbit email.
- T+48h: shipping confirmation + calendar invites.
- T+3 days: pre-onboard packet + FAQs (how to VPN, who to contact).
- T-3 days before start: Slack intro + team post.
- Day 3 & Day 10: quick 15m check-ins from AOC.

Sample short scripts (for phone or chat):
- If candidate is delayed receiving hardware: "I’m tracking this with IT — we’ve escalated to next-day replacement. Can you confirm if you have a spare machine we can temporarily provision access on?"
- If candidate needs alternate OS: "Manager approved alternate OS? Please confirm and IT will create custom image; expect +3 business days."

Open questions / TODOs (research items):
- Can we enable MDM zero-touch provisioning for international vendors to cut ship time? (cost estimate?)
- Should contractors get reduced hardware allocation (one-time stipend option)? Pilot with 3 hires.
- Formalize SLA between People Ops and IT: proposed 48h SLAs for domestic, 5 business days for international. Need sign-off.

Mini interview rubric addendum (for quick hires under 2-week cycle):
- Minimum: 2 interviewers, 30–45m each.
- Ask: 1 system design or architecture question + 1 behavioral scenario + 1 role-specific take-home or coding probe.
- Passing signal: candidate articulates trade-offs and past ownership; interviewer notes contain at least one concrete result (metric, shipped feature).

Back-of-envelope metrics to track (AOC dashboard inputs):
- Offer->Acceptance median time (days).
- Acceptance->HardwareDelivered median time (days).
- Day0 access success rate (% with all accounts by EOD).
- Candidate satisfaction (post-14d NPS, 1–10).

Quick links & bookmarks (placeholders):
- Onboarding checklist template: confluence:ONBOARD-REMOTE-2026
- Hardware vendor invoice template: drive:it/fulfillment/invoices

Notes to self (Asha):
- Test localized customs packets for UK/EU hires next week.
- Run 2-person pilot where candidate picks stipend vs shipped device.
- Sync with Security on MFA exemptions for contractor VMs.

Revision history: v0.1 — initial draft 2026-01-28 (pilot learnings). v0.2 — added international shipping notes 2026-02-10. v0.3 — consolidated rubric + metrics 2026-03-01.

End — ping me in Slack if you want me to trim templates into a single sender checklist or make a new Jira automation for acceptance triggers.
